messages.Screener.Faq.WhatIs.Question: What is a crypto screener?
messages.Screener.Faq.WhatIs.Answer: A crypto screener is a tool that filters the cryptocurrency market by criteria such as market capitalization, price performance, trading volume and category, so you can quickly narrow thousands of coins down to the ones that match your strategy.
messages.Screener.Faq.HowToFilter.Question: How do I filter cryptocurrencies with the FXEmpire screener?
messages.Screener.Faq.HowToFilter.Answer: Use the filter bar above the table to set a category, market cap or fully diluted valuation range, price change over a chosen timeframe, 24h trading volume or technical rating. Filters apply instantly, and the page URL updates so you can share or bookmark any filtered view.
messages.Screener.Faq.DataUpdates.Question: How often is the screener data updated?
messages.Screener.Faq.DataUpdates.Answer: Prices, market capitalization and trading volume refresh continuously throughout the day from market data providers, so the screener always reflects near real-time market conditions.
messages.Screener.Faq.TaRating.Question: What does the technical rating mean?
messages.Screener.Faq.TaRating.Answer: The technical rating condenses popular technical indicators — moving averages and oscillators computed on the daily timeframe — into a single signal from Strong Buy to Strong Sell. It covers the largest coins by market cap and updates hourly. It is not investment advice.
messages.Screener.Faq.SaveScreens.Question: Can I save my screener filters?
messages.Screener.Faq.SaveScreens.Answer: Yes. Sign in to save your current filters as a named screen and re-apply them with one click, or turn on "Remember filters" to restore your last setup automatically. You can also share any filtered view simply by copying the page URL.

Article.MainPaginatedMetaTitle: Expert Market Forecasts: In-Depth Analysis & Price Predictions - page {page}
Article.MainMetaDescription: Explore FXEmpire's comprehensive market forecasts, in-depth analysis, and insightful price predictions to make informed decisions and enhance your trading performance.
Article.InstrumentMetaTitle: {instrument} Price Forecasts Today: Expert Analysis & Predictions
Article.InstrumentMetaDescription: Discover today's {instrument} price forecast with expert analysis, {instrument} price predictions, in-depth {instrument} technical analysis, and the latest economic events to help you navigate the {instrument} market confidently
Article.ForecastAnalystTooltip: Price targets set by FXEmpire’s analysts across three horizons — the coming weeks, 3–6 months and a year ahead. Each range shows where the analyst expects {instrument} to trade; the percentage is the distance from the current price. Reviewed after major market events and at least weekly. Estimates, not investment advice.
Article.ForecastSnapshotTooltip: The overall signal aggregates {total} technical indicators — moving averages and oscillators — calculated on the daily (1D) chart. BUY means most indicators point upward, SELL downward, NEUTRAL mixed. Key levels are Classic daily pivot points (Pivot, supports S1–S3, resistances R1–R3) computed from the previous session’s high, low and close.
Article.ForecastSnapshotToggleLabel: Show or hide the technical snapshot
Article.ForecastGaugeGroupLabel: Technical summary, daily chart: {signal} — {buy} of {total} indicators point up
Article.ForecastLevelsCaption: Key levels today · based on daily pivot points
Article.ForecastLevelsTooltip: Support is a price where falls have recently tended to pause; resistance is where rises have tended to stall. Both are Classic pivot points calculated from yesterday’s high, low and close — they refresh every trading day.
Article.ForecastWeeklyRangeTooltip: The band {instrument} is statistically likely to trade in this week, based on its current volatility (ATR). A wider band means a choppier market.
Article.ForecastNoAnalystIntro: FXEmpire analysts don’t currently publish price targets for this instrument. The signal below is generated from {indicators} and updates through the trading day.
Article.ForecastSeasonalityTooltip: Average monthly return over the available history (10–20 years). Months with thinner history can deviate from the long-run pattern.
